diff_text: Line 241: Line 241: ==Trivia== ==Trivia== *The '''Golden Demoman''' is the first mainstream golden tower in 6 years to be added to the game since the [[Golden Soldier]] in 2020. **This is true if not including the [[Golden Snowballer]], which is exclusive to developers and [[Sandbox Mode]]. **It is also the first golden tower since the [[Golden Soldier]] to be added to the [[Golden Crate]]. *The '''Golden Demoman's''' Level 3 upgrade name, ''Loose Cannon'', may be a reference to the ''Team Fortress 2'' weapon of the same name. *The '''Golden Demoman's''' Level 3 upgrade name, ''Loose Cannon'', may be a reference to the ''Team Fortress 2'' weapon of the same name. *The '''Golden Demoman's''' Level 4 upgrade name, ''A Thousand Exploding Suns'', may be a reference to the [[w:c:Robert Reynolds (Earth-616)|Sentry]] from ''Marvel'', who is described as having the power of a thousand exploding suns. *The '''Golden Demoman's''' Level 4 upgrade name, ''A Thousand Exploding Suns'', may be a reference to the [[w:c:Robert Reynolds (Earth-616)|Sentry]] from ''Marvel'', who is described as having the power of a thousand exploding suns.
